subject: [PATCH 10/22] mm/khugepaged: restrict collapse to common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch restricts the collapse operation in the mm/khugepaged module to only common memory, which is memory that can be shared between processes. The existing checks for zone device pages are replaced with a check for common memory using the page_is_common_memory() function. Additionally, a new check is added to the collapse_scan_file() function to ensure that page-cache folios are also restricted to common memory.
